title: Public Alert No. 010/2025 – Alert on the Sale of a Fake Product Named Wonder Calcium by Health and Hygiene

products.manufacturer: Falsely stated as Asad Pharmaceutical Ltd; actually produced by Health and Hygiene, Atiku Abubakar Plaza, International Trade Fair Complex, Badagry Expressway, Lagos State

summary: NAFDAC warns of a falsified product, Wonder Calcium, bearing fake NAFDAC registration number 04-1029 and falsely claiming manufacture by Asad Pharmaceutical Ltd. It is produced and sold by Health and Hygiene in Lagos. A distributor has been apprehended.
